summary: Tech led the way into the weekend as megacaps rallied and the Dow added over 400 points, closing out a winning week. Telecoms were the big casualty as SpaceX wireless plans sent Verizon toward its worst day since 2002.
market_note: S&P futures closed up 0.58% at 4:11 PM ET; indexes posted weekly gains as oil prices eased and tech shares rebounded.

items.why: Analysts see Amazon as attractively valued ahead of Q3 earnings on Oct 29, with accelerating AWS growth set against heavy AI capex spending.
Bernstein reiterated an Outperform rating and a $641 price target, pushing back on AI spending fears. Microsoft is nearing a $4 trillion market cap for the first time in nearly a year.
Musk clarified that Tesla and SpaceX will share the $100B-plus Terafab chip project, and Tesla registered a record 150 more Cybercabs in Texas. Tigress reiterated a $550 target.
CEO Lisa Su said AI chip demand will outrun supply into 2027 with a substantial output ramp planned. Tight HBM memory supply and profit-taking after a 200%+ 2026 rally weighed.
